headline: Dow Jumps 612, Nasdaq Climbs 513, S&P 500 Rises 106
summary: Brent crude fell 7.8% to $101.27 as stock markets rallied worldwide on hopes the US and Iran are nearing a deal to let ships carry Persian Gulf crude again.
why: The Dow, Nasdaq and S&P 500 are the main US equity benchmarks, and their moves reflect broad investor sentiment toward energy and geopolitical risk.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Hopes of a US-Iran deal reopening Gulf shipping lifted broad equity markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hopes that the US and Iran are nearing a deal to restore Persian Gulf crude shipments drove oil sharply lower and lifted stock markets worldwide.
